title: NSGo game netplay wire message schema (version 1)
description: Schema is the root of a versioned *.wire.yaml document describing binary wire enums, messages, and discriminated unions.

version.description: Version is the schema format version; it must equal CurrentVersion (1).

package.description: Package is the Go package name emitted by cmd/gamewire when -pkg is not specified.

order.description: Order is the default byte order for multi-byte fields in this file ("be" or "le"; defaults to "be" when omitted).

imports.description: Imports lists relative paths to sibling *.wire.yaml files in the same package whose enums and messages this schema references.

enums.description: Enums declares named integer enumerations validated on decode.

messages.description: Messages declares binary wire message layouts.

unions.description: Unions declares tag- or nibble-discriminated message envelopes.

ArraySpec.description: ArraySpec configures a fixed-count ([N]T) or length-prefixed ([]T) array field.

count.description: Count fixes the array length to a compile-time constant [Count]T; omit or set 0 for a variable-length slice.

length.description: Length sets the element-count prefix for variable-length arrays ("uvarint", "u8", "u16", or "u32"; defaults to "uvarint").

order.description: Order overrides the byte order for a multi-byte Length prefix (and as default for elements when OfOrder is omitted).

of.description: Of is the element wire type: a primitive ("u8", "u16", "u32", "u64", "i8", "i16", "i32", "i64", "uvarint", "svarint", "bool", "f32") or the name of a declared Enum or Message.

ofOrder.description: OfOrder overrides the byte order of multi-byte primitive elements ("be" or "le").

ofBits.description: OfBits sets the Go integer bit width (8, 16, 32, or 64) when Of is "uvarint" or "svarint".

maxLength.description: MaxLength bounds the decoded element count of variable-length arrays (0 means unbounded).

Discriminator.description: Discriminator configures the leading tag encoding of a Union.

type.description: Type selects the discriminator wire encoding: "u8", "u16", "uvarint", or "nibble" (a 1-byte high/low bit split).

order.description: Order overrides the byte order when Type is "u16" ("be" or "le").

highBits.description: HighBits is the width in bits (1..7) of the high field when Type is "nibble" (defaults to 4).

highName.description: HighName is the Go field name for the high bits when Type is "nibble" (defaults to "version").

highValue.description: HighValue is the expected constant value of the high bits when Type is "nibble" (for example, 2 for replication v2).

lowName.description: LowName is the logical name of the low tag bits when Type is "nibble" (defaults to "type").

Enum.description: Enum defines a named integer enumeration on the wire.

name.description: Name is the Go type name of the enum, in PascalCase.

doc.description: Doc is an optional comment emitted on the generated Go type.

type.description: Type is the underlying integer wire type ("u8", "u16", "u32", "u64", or "uvarint").

order.description: Order overrides the schema byte order for multi-byte enum types ("be" or "le").

values.description: Values lists the enum's named members and their wire integers.

EnumValue.description: EnumValue is one named member of an Enum.

name.description: Name is the member name, appended to the enum type name to form the Go constant.

value.description: Value is the unsigned wire integer value of the member.

doc.description: Doc is an optional comment emitted on the generated Go constant.

Field.description: Field defines one field of a Message or MaskSpec.

name.description: Name is the field name (snake_case or lowerCamelCase); codegen converts it to an exported Go field name.

doc.description: Doc is an optional comment emitted on the generated Go struct field.

type.description: Type is a built-in wire type ("u8", "u16", "u32", "u64", "i8", "i16", "i32", "i64", "uvarint", "svarint", "bool", "f32", "qfloat", "fixed", "bytes", "string", "array", "bits", "mask") or the name of a declared Enum or Message.

order.description: Order overrides the message/schema byte order for multi-byte primitives, length prefixes, or mask integers ("be" or "le").

bits.description: Bits specifies the bit width for "bits" fields (1..64) or the Go integer width (8, 16, 32, or 64) for "uvarint"/"svarint" fields.

const.description: Const fixes an unsigned integer, bits, or enum wire field to a single constant value written on encode and verified on decode.

qfloat.description: QFloat configures an integer-quantized float32 field when Type is "qfloat".

fixed.description: Fixed configures an integer-scaled fixed-point float64 field when Type is "fixed".

length.description: Length configures the length encoding for "bytes" and "string" fields ("uvarint", "u8", "u16", "u32", or "rest"; defaults to "uvarint").

maxLength.description: MaxLength bounds the decoded byte length of variable-length "bytes" and "string" fields (0 means unbounded).

array.description: Array configures a fixed-size or length-prefixed array field when Type is "array".

mask.description: Mask configures a presence-bitmask group of optional fields when Type is "mask".

FixedSpec.description: FixedSpec configures a fixed-point number stored as an integer scaled by Scale.

scale.description: Scale is the positive integer scale factor (wire integer equals round(value * Scale)).

type.description: Type is the underlying integer wire type ("i8", "i16", "i32", "i64", "u8", "u16", "u32", "u64", "uvarint", or "svarint").

order.description: Order overrides the byte order for multi-byte integer wire types ("be" or "le").

MaskSpec.description: MaskSpec configures a presence-bitmask group that gates its fields in bit order (bit 0, bit 1, ...).

type.description: Type is the mask integer wire type ("u8", "u16", "u32", or "u64"; defaults to "u8").

order.description: Order overrides the byte order for multi-byte mask types ("be" or "le").

delta.description: Delta, when true, generates Diff<Message>(base, cur) and Apply<Message>(dst, delta) helpers comparing float bit patterns and byte slices directly.

fields.description: Fields lists the gated fields in bit order (index i corresponds to bit 1<<i).

Message.description: Message defines one binary wire message struct and its ordered sequence of fields.

name.description: Name is the Go struct name of the message, in PascalCase.

doc.description: Doc is an optional comment emitted on the generated Go struct.

order.description: Order overrides the schema default byte order for fields of this message ("be" or "le").

fields.description: Fields lists the wire fields in exact on-the-wire order.

QFloatSpec.description: QFloatSpec configures integer-only quantization of a float32 across [Min, Max] into Bits unsigned bits.

min.description: Min is the finite lower bound mapped to 0.

max.description: Max is the finite upper bound mapped to (1<<Bits)-1; it must be strictly greater than Min.

bits.description: Bits is the quantized bit width, from 1 to 32.

Union.description: Union defines a discriminated message envelope selecting one of Cases by a leading tag or nibble-split header byte.

name.description: Name is the Go struct name of the union envelope, in PascalCase.

doc.description: Doc is an optional comment emitted on the generated Go struct.

discriminator.description: Discriminator configures how the leading tag (and optional nibble-split version) is encoded on the wire.

cases.description: Cases maps discriminator tags to member messages.

UnionCase.description: UnionCase binds one discriminator tag value to a Message inside a Union.

name.description: Name is the Go field name inside the union struct (defaults to Message when omitted).

tag.description: Tag is the discriminator tag value selecting this case.

message.description: Message is the name of the Message encoded after the discriminator.

doc.description: Doc is an optional comment emitted on the generated tag constant.
